contract_template_defaults.site_and_right_evidence: Required before G1: official parcel/site basis, access right, boundary limitations and unresolved conflicts; no organizer-supplied official geometry is currently available.
contract_template_defaults.permissions_and_insurance: Required before installation: named permitting route, professional sign-off, construction/event safety plan, public liability and participant cover as applicable.
contract_template_defaults.capital_cost_class: Use each contract cost_class only as a concept resource band; appoint an authorized cost professional before any funding decision.
contract_template_defaults.operations_cost_class: Declare staffed hours, utilities, moderation, accessibility assistance, archive and complaint handling before G2.
contract_template_defaults.maintenance_cost_class: Declare inspection interval, named maintainer, spares, cleaning, software/security support and fault response before G2.
contract_template_defaults.removal_cost_class: Declare isolation, removal, recovery, surface reinstatement, data closure and disposal route before G1.
contract_template_defaults.acceptance_evidence: Signed site/right evidence; professional and accessibility review; AI-on/AI-off paired test; fault and evacuation drill; public objection receipt; removal/return-use record.
contract_template_defaults.application_rule: Every C01-C08 contract inherits these eight defaults and adds its own accountable_actor, required_professions, baseline, closure and return_use fields below. Blank or unverified evidence means STOP, not assumed approval.

contracts.baseline: 连续步行、夜间照明、休息与人工求助现场审计
contracts.closure: 公众主链不连续或维护责任缺失
contracts.return_use: 保留普通公园通行与纸质导览

contracts.baseline: 河道、交通、能耗、消防与公众路径基线
contracts.closure: 急停、隔离、人工复核或复原演练失败
contracts.return_use: 撤除试验构件，庭院恢复公共学习

contracts.accountable_actor: 待授权校区/园区运营主体
contracts.baseline: 开放时段、首层可达、许可与维护能力
contracts.closure: 许可不清、维护者失联或撤回不可执行
contracts.return_use: 工坊恢复为图书馆和普通协作空间

contracts.accountable_actor: 待授权属地空间运营主体
contracts.baseline: 四象限到达、人流、投诉、夜间声光与人工服务
contracts.closure: 测试被误读为采购、通行冲突或投诉链断裂
contracts.return_use: 撤出试译亭，保留休息、过街和人工咨询

contracts.accountable_actor: 待授权公共空间运营主体
contracts.baseline: 视线、结构、触读、低眩光和内容更新责任
contracts.closure: 结构、文保、无障碍或内容更新审查失败
contracts.return_use: 拆除复原，不留废弃数字设施

contracts.accountable_actor: 各场景未来授权运营主体
contracts.baseline: 任务脚本、失败样本、人工接管和非数字路径
contracts.closure: 任一回执字段、公共回报或人工兜底缺失
contracts.return_use: 降级为人工服务或普通公共界面

contracts.accountable_actor: 待授权联合运营秘书处
contracts.baseline: 字段、保存期限、公开范围和纠错责任
contracts.closure: 版本、来源、责任、退出或复核日期缺失
contracts.return_use: 导出纸质登记并停止在线发布

contracts.baseline: 问题、失败、公众改变、退场与下一责任人清单
contracts.closure: 不能公开失败或找不到下一责任人
contracts.return_use: 取消活动，仅发布经清权的年度书面回译包

cost_class_legend.S: 既有人员、资料与轻量活动
cost_class_legend.M: 可拆构件、专项服务与受控测试
cost_class_legend.L: 工程或长期运营，须另行论证

disclaimer_zh: 费用只分资源类别，不给出未经财务、权属和工程核定的金额；所有主体名称均为角色建议而非承诺。
